description: Defines the geographic bounds of the dataset as an axis-aligned box. Each min_*/max_* pair gives the extent along the corresponding axis of the object's coordinate_reference_system (min_x/max_x is the first axis, min_y/max_y the second, min_z/max_z the third). The x, y, z labels denote the CRS axes in order.

min_x.description: Minimum value along the first axis (x) of the object's coordinate reference system.

max_x.description: Maximum value along the first axis (x) of the object's coordinate reference system.

min_y.description: Minimum value along the second axis (y) of the object's coordinate reference system.

max_y.description: Maximum value along the second axis (y) of the object's coordinate reference system.

min_z.description: Minimum value along the third axis (z) of the object's coordinate reference system.

max_z.description: Maximum value along the third axis (z) of the object's coordinate reference system.
